Microsoft Defender for Endpoint update for EDR Sensor

Summary

This update for Microsoft Defender for Endpoint updates the EDR sensor to version 10.8839.26080.2008. It applies to Windows 10, Windows 11 and Windows Server 2019 and later.

Known issues in this update

Some devices stop reporting telemetry and stay stuck in pending until they are restarted. Microsoft is working on a resolution and will provide an update in an upcoming release.

Restart requirement

You do not have to restart the device after you apply this update.

How to get this update

Microsoft Update, WSUS and the Microsoft Update Catalog. Earlier: 10.8835.26070.1004.
